What We Do

End-to-end manufacturing expertise,
from strategy to execution

We look across the entire manufacturing value chain — strategy, sales, engineering, operations, and aftermarket — to identify and capture measurable value.

Operations & Supply Chain Improvement

S&OP assessments, inventory strategy, procurement optimization, and KPI development across multi-site manufacturing operations. We diagnose root causes and build the roadmap to fix them.

→ $8M working capital improvement · $2.5M direct material savings

PE Portfolio & Growth Strategy

Pre-deal due diligence and post-acquisition value creation for PE-backed manufacturers. Aftermarket strategy, growth initiative development, and EBITDA improvement roadmaps.

→ 30% revenue uplift for $2.4B PE-owned industrial company

Manufacturing Footprint & Cost Optimization

Multi-plant consolidation analysis, direct cost benchmarking, and scenario modeling across geographies. We build the financial case management needs to make confident decisions.

→ $80M+ projected savings across 10+ plants in 5 countries

Digital Transformation & ERP/CRM

ERP (SAP, Oracle) and CRM (Salesforce Manufacturing Cloud) strategy, implementation oversight, and adoption programs. We bridge the gap between business operations and technology delivery.

→ $40M ROI roadmap · 2,000+ users impacted

Product Lifecycle & NPI Management

PLM process assessment, SKU rationalization, multi-generation product planning, and NPI acceleration. From engineering to market — faster, with less working capital tied up in the wrong inventory.

→ 50% lead-time reduction plan · 25–40% lead-time improvement

Go-To-Market & Aftermarket Strategy

B2B GTM strategy, aftermarket business development, channel strategy, and sales operations improvement. We build the frameworks and then work alongside your team to execute them.

→ 150% sales goal attainment · $1M+ services deal at North America OEM

About

John Chou
Principal, MFG360 Ops

MFG360 Ops is the consulting practice of John Chou, an independent manufacturing and operations consultant with over 20 years of hands-on experience across the full manufacturing value chain — from engineering and NPI through supply chain, operations, and go-to-market strategy.

John has advised PE-backed industrials, F500 manufacturers, and global supply chains as both an operator and consultant. His career spans roles at PricewaterhouseCoopers (PRTM Management Consultants), Salesforce, EPAM Systems, Tech Mahindra, and Leonardo DRS — as well as independent engagements across automotive, aerospace & defense, HVAC, consumer electronics, and industrial equipment sectors.

He is fluent in Mandarin and Taiwanese, holds patents in electrical product design, and has published research on defense supply chain risk management. He is a registered Salesforce AppExchange ISV Partner.
